issue.title: Realtime northbound capital flow is labeled with the historical requested date.

steps: Analyze 600519 as of 2025-06-13 (point-in-time review of that trading day).
expected: Historical analysis should omit realtime snapshots or explicitly label their point-in-time limitation.
defect: Realtime northbound capital flow is labeled with the historical requested date.

fault location.explanation: The date labels live data without a historical-date guard.

Root cause: get_northbound_flow uses curr_date in its header but always fetches the live dayChart endpoint without a historical guard. The source was checked at the archived tested revision. Archived H1 and concept-block H2 observations occur in ten executed runs, but Judge submission failed due to evidence size. Docker failures before execution are not hits. Mootdx TCP failure is an ABB limitation; H3 remains untested. Live values vary. No fresh runtime reproduction was performed during this organization. Exact first fixing commit has not been established. Root steps describe the selected original case; other run-local cases can differ. Retained observations are not automatically independent same-prompt trials.
